description: A Windline cycling tour's route, day by day: "What's the Durban Tour 2027 route?", "Give me the GPX files for Alistair's tour", "Where is Alistair's Durban tour?". On the tour's days its card offers a tap on the back for the organiser (tap_on_the_back with tour). To fly over day 3 of a tour ("Give me the flyover for day 3 of TSF 2026"), pass day: 3. Finds a published tour by its name, its address or its organiser's or club's name, and returns each day (from and to, distance, climbing, start time), a map of every day, and the weather (the live forecast within 10 days, 10 years of weather on the date beyond). Route files (GPX, Garmin .fit) only when the organiser lets riders download them; otherwise say "The organiser hasn't made the route files available." Never make up a file link. If several tours match, ask which.

day.description: One day of the tour to fly over (1 for day 1), when the user asks for a day: the flyover of that day and its Fly it in 3D link.

tour.description: The tour's name, address or organiser, e.g. "ProLend 2027 Durban Tour", "AllyCat".

units.description: Pass the asker's units: imperial for users in the US, UK road distances, Liberia or Myanmar, or when they ask in miles/°F; otherwise metric.

name: tour_route

outputSchema.description: A Windline cycling tour's route, day by day.

can_tap.description: A tap on the back for the tour would reach its organiser now (its days; their switches on).

day.description: With day: the day flown over (1 for day 1).

days.description: Each day: label, from, to, km, climb_m, start (ISO), and its weather.

error.description: When the call failed: what went wrong, in words for the user.

fly_url.description: With day: Fly it in 3D, Windline's Fly the route for that day.

gpx.description: When route_files: each day's GPX link (day, url). Never make one up.

message.description: When view is "none": what to tell the user (no match, not live yet, a question back).

route_files.description: Whether the organiser lets riders download the route files.

signup.description: Without a sign-in: { label, url } to make a free Windline or RunFast account (?ref=mcp).

sponsor_line.description: The line every answer ends with: who brings livedot's live tracking free.

tours.description: Several tours matched: their names. Ask which one.

view.description: What this answer is; "none" when there is nothing to show (see message).
